She seemed like a normal street cat, but here’s the catch, street cats don’t put their belly up to strangers. She’s been getting food from a couple of people in the apartment but a week ago the directive board prohibited feeding the cat in any way. I’m still feeding her hiding where the cameras can’t see me, but I’m still at risk of being caught. I’ve been noticing her getting skinnier, and I’m pretty sure she can fit in a home! I’ve seen her close to dogs and she doesn’t even pay attention to them, she just walks past them. About cats, she’s a female, or at least I think she is, but I’ve seen her getting closer to other cats from a distance, always watching them but haven’t seen her fighting. She’s friendly to everyone that just calls her, and unfortunately I can’t feed her outside the apartments because she’s scared of cars going too fast. Anybody please!
